description: The indicators read for a US recession, each beside the line it is read against and whether it is past it: the New York Fed's yield-curve model (the chance of being in recession twelve months ahead, computed as the New York Fed publishes it, month by month), the Sahm rule, the 10-year less 2-year curve and its last inversion, jobless claims against a year earlier, the Chauvet-Piger probability, GDPNow, and the Fed Board staff's excess bond premium model. A plain summary first. No key.

months.description: Months of the yield-curve model's probability shown, latest last; default 13.

name: recession_watch

outputSchema.description: rows are indicators in the order of columns, each with its latest reading, the line it is read against and whether it is past it; yield_curve_model is the New York Fed model's chance month by month.

title: Recession indicators against their lines
